meta.name: 181-java-observability-logging
meta.description: Use when you need to implement or improve Java logging and observability — including selecting SLF4J with Logback/Log4j2, applying proper log levels (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE), parameterized logging, correlation context, secure logging without sensitive data exposure, environment-specific configuration, log aggregation, monitoring, and alerting. This should trigger for requests such as Improve logging; Apply logging; Refactor logging; Add logging support. Part of cursor-rules-java project

copy.tagline: 提升 Java 应用的可观测性与日志质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Java 项目中系统化地改进日志记录与监控告警。
